$comment: The machine-readable profile the least-effort protocol family expects. Published as data: this storefront implements none of these protocols, and the capability entries below say so in the protocol's own terms rather than by omission.

merchant.name: ax-kit reference storefront
merchant.description: A small shop that publishes its capabilities as typed tools.

payment.$comment: Present because the profile shape requires the key, empty because there is no integration to describe. An empty object is a truthful answer; omitting the key would be ambiguous between 'no' and 'not written yet'.

agent_tool_surface.$comment: What this storefront actually offers an agent, which is the one capability here that is real. The tools are enumerated by the page at runtime rather than hard-coded in this file, because a copy of a list is a second source of truth for something the page already knows.
agent_tool_surface.note: A tool surface describes this page to an agent that is already present. It is not an agent acting on the shop's behalf over a payment rail, and it is not a substitute for any of the protocols above.
